title: flow plugin — per-repo config
description: Per-repo configuration consumed by the flow plugin's commands, skills, and subagents. Place at <repo>/.ai/workflows.config.json. Missing file = sensible defaults; missing keys = same.

name.description: Short project / product name. Resolves the `<project>` placeholder in commands and file paths (e.g. `.ai/<project>-prd.md` → `.ai/<name>-prd.md`).

language.description: Primary language used in plans, decisions, and review notes. ISO 639-1 (e.g. `en`, `cs`). Cosmetic — does not change plugin behaviour, only signals the team's preferred tone.

theme.description: Default theme target. `dark` and `light` enable theme-first contrast validation in a11y-rules; `agnostic` checks both.

paths.description: Where to find canonical project context files. Defaults follow `<project>` placeholder convention.

platforms.description: Platform variants the project ships to. Drives scenario-runner matrix and responsive-rules density mapping.

bundleIdPrefix.description: Native app bundle ID prefix (e.g. `com.acme.myapp`). Used by `/verify` and `/scenario` when launching native builds. Omit for web-only projects.

boundaries.description: Integration boundaries the project crosses. debugging-rules and testing-rules treat these as no-mock zones and demand evidence at the seam.

motion.description: Motion duration budgets in milliseconds. motion-rules enforces these as hard ceilings.

customPulses.description: Named long-running ambient animations (e.g. `liveIndicator: 1500`). Exempt from the page/complex caps because they're loops, not transitions.

responsive.description: Responsive layout knobs. responsive-rules reads this to enforce density-per-platform.

densityMap.description: Maps each entry in `platforms` to a density preset (`command-center` | `sideline-tool` | `palm-friendly` | `cozy` | `compact` | custom). responsive-rules uses this to flag wrong density per platform.

breakpoints.description: Named breakpoint tokens (px). Override only if project differs from defaults.

ux.description: UX hard targets surfaced to design-system-guard and any project-local UX critic.

responseTargetMs.description: User-perceived response time ceiling for primary interactions.

bilingual.description: ISO 639-1 codes the UI ships in (e.g. `["cs", "en"]`). Empty = monolingual.

skills.description: Per-skill toggles. Each enforcement skill respects its own `enabled` flag (default `true`).

integrations.description: Lightweight pointers to external services the project plugs into. Generic commands read `provider` and decide whether to offer integration actions; project-specific shape (list IDs, custom field names, milestone hierarchies) lives in `defaults`. Document non-obvious conventions in `.ai/decisions/` as DDRs.

tracker.description: Issue / task tracker. Used by /flow:done, /flow:bug-rca, /flow:bug-fix to optionally create or update tickets.

mcp.description: MCP tool name prefix used to call the provider (e.g. `mcp__claude_ai_ClickUp`, `mcp__github`). Generic commands resolve tool names by appending the operation (`<mcp>_<op>`). Omit if no MCP server is configured — commands will print payloads for manual handling.

defaults.description: Free-form project-specific defaults (list IDs, milestone names, custom field IDs, status labels, …). Generic commands pass this object through to MCP calls untouched. Schema-free on purpose — your tracker's idiosyncrasies belong here, not in the plugin.

analytics.description: Product analytics provider (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, …). Currently informational — surfaces in scenario reports and DDRs as context.

ci.description: CI / deploy provider (GitHub Actions, Vercel, Netlify, EAS, …). Used by /flow:validate to know where to look for build status.

design.description: Design source-of-truth (Figma, Penpot, Sketch, …). Used by /flow:plan when the planning input references design.
